stem.text: A student reacts $1\,\text{mol}$ of magnesium powder in a sealed $0.030\,\text{m}^{3}$ container of oxygen at a pressure of $2.0 \times 10^{5}\,\text{Pa}$ and a temperature of $600\,\text{K}$. The magnesium reacts completely to form $\text{MgO}$.
Which percentage of the oxygen will be used up?
